claim: Adaptive fusion achieves +0.1490 Delta AUROC over fixed fusion under missing token logprobs
recommended_wording: Under complete absence of token log-probabilities (Mask [1,0,1]), adaptive fusion achieves an AUROC of 0.9910 compared to 0.8420 for fixed fusion.

claim: Platt calibration reduces Expected Calibration Error from 0.1972 to 0.0937
evidence: Table 7: Platt scaling on held-out test split
recommended_wording: Post-hoc Platt logistic calibration reduces Expected Calibration Error (ECE) from 0.1972 to 0.0937.

claim: Selective prediction achieves 0.00% risk at 80% coverage
recommended_wording: On the evaluated test population, the retained 80% coverage subset exhibited zero observed classification errors under the pre-selected validation operating threshold.

claim: Closed-loop repair achieves 88.4% CSR and 2.1% CIHR
recommended_wording: Downstream closed-loop repair achieves an 88.4% Correction Success Rate while independent re-verification limits secondary error induction to 2.1%.

claim: HalluciSense achieves 0.9964 AUROC on composite external benchmark N=850

claim: Tri-pillar hybrid fusion outperforms single-pillar verifiers alone
